purpose: Timing integrity audit only; no results are changed and no performance acceptance is inferred.

definitions.process_wall: Original runner time.perf_counter duration around posix_spawn plus wait4.
definitions.phase: Application logged elapsed seconds, normally a subset of process runtime.
definitions.utc_wrapper_span: Runner UTC timestamps surrounding the separate measurement driver; includes additional overhead.
definitions.limitations: Flags identify inconsistent clocks/boundaries or suspicious metadata; absence of flags does not establish comparable host conditions. Completed runs in incomplete cases are included only for integrity checks.
